purpose: One prominent message or key sentence, with emphasis in the accent colour.
accessibility: The statement is the only content. Its text is drawn in the theme's text colour and strong text in the accent colour, a theme pair that meets WCAG AA on the background. The text scales down within the theme's type scale (title to body) to stay inside the safe area; below body size it is a validation warning. Over background footage the text sits on a theme scrim (task 039).
